entities.summary: John James Hughes was a Welsh engineer, businessman and founder of the city of Donetsk. The village was originally named Yuzovka or Yuzivka after Hughes,, formally becoming a town in May 1917 and later, in 1924, being renamed to Stalino ; in 1961, the name was changed to Donetsk.
